body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy on a solid surface within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and make it Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, suppress 1 point of its ordinary Movement bonuses until the start of your next turn.
After a hit, end one ordinary effect allowing that target to ignore difficult terrain.

rider.title: Earth Thread
rider.html: Gain an Earth Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: yourself or one willing target of that card reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 before the start of your next turn.
